description: List every toolset this server groups its tools into: id, title, description, member tool names, and whether it's currently enabled. Only `catalog` and `auth` are enabled by default to keep the visible tool list small — use `set_toolset` to turn on the group a task actually needs (e.g. `basket_and_checkout` before placing an order). Call this first if you're unsure which toolset covers what you need. Read-only, no network call.
name: list_toolsets

locked.description: Present when this deployment refuses to enable the toolset; the reason why.

title: List available toolsets
